portal_hypertension.title: Quantitative MRI to Assess Portal Pressure in Patients With Liver Disease: Validation at 3 T.
portal_hypertension.authors: Bradley CR, Scott R, Cox EF
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 40）。核心观点：数据来自 40 名参与者（15 名代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝病 [MASLD]/13 名酒精相关性肝病 [ArLD]/12 名其他，55 ± 14 岁）在 1.5 T 下扫描（回顾性）和 42 名参与者（21 名 MASLD/14 ArLD/7 名其他，60 ± 12 岁）扫描数据 临床提示：数据来自 40 名参与者（15 名代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病 [MASLD]/13 名酒精相关性肝病 [ArLD]/12 名其他，55 ± 14 岁），以 1.5 T（回顾性）扫描，42 名参与者（21 MAS）
portal_hypertension.abstract: Hepatic venous pressure gradient (HVPG) is the gold standard for assessing portal hypertension (PH). We previously demonstrated that a bivariate MRI model combining liver T 1 and splenic artery velocity at 1.5 T correlates with HVPG. This study aimed to evaluate this model at 3 T and investigate additional splanchnic MRI measures as potential non-invasive markers of portal pressure. portal_hypertension.title: Successful staged endoscopic treatment of multiple gastrointestinal varices caused by oxaliplatin-induced sinusoidal obstruction syndrome.
portal_hypertension.authors: Kinsho N, Kato T, Hikichi T
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：正弦波阻塞综合征是一种与奥沙利铂化疗相关的众所周知的肝血管损伤，可导致非肝硬化门静脉高压。 临床提示：尽管脾肿大和血小板减少是常见的临床表现，但临床上显着的胃肠静脉曲张可能在奥沙利铂停药后持续存在或新出现。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Sinusoidal obstruction syndrome is a well-known hepatic vascular injury associated with oxaliplatin-based chemotherapy and can lead to non-cirrhotic portal hypertension. Although splenomegaly and thrombocytopenia are common clinical manifestations, clinically significant gastrointestinal varices may persist or newly develop after oxaliplatin cessation. The optimal therapeutic strategy for multiple gastrointestinal varices caused by oxaliplatin-induced sinusoidal obstruction syndrome remains unclear. Here, we report a case of a 71-year-old man who developed non-cirrhotic portal hypertension after oxaliplatin-based adjuvant chemotherapy for rectal cancer. Contrast-enhanced computed tomography ...

portal_hypertension.title: Sustained normalization of hydrogen-positive small intestinal bacterial overgrowth after polyethylene glycol bowel preparation.
portal_hypertension.authors: Yokoyama K, Tominaga K, Kojima Y
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：我们报告一例44岁男性，患有代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪性肝炎，并发肝内门静脉血栓和食管胃静脉曲张。 临床提示：小肠细菌过度生长 (SIBO) 是慢性肝病合并门脉高压的常见并发症，尽管经过标准治疗，该病通常持续存在或复发。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Small intestinal bacterial overgrowth (SIBO) is a frequent complication of chronic liver disease with portal hypertension that often persists or recurs despite standard treatments. Polyethylene glycol (PEG)-based bowel preparations are routinely used before colonoscopy; however, their effects on SIBO have not yet been systematically evaluated. We report the case of a 44-year-old man with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis, complicated by intrahepatic portal vein thrombosis and esophagogastric varices. portal_hypertension.title: Discordant 2D shear wave elastography values in post-Fontan patients with ascites: a potential interpretive pitfall.
portal_hypertension.authors: Abdulla M, Al-Hashimi H, Kalis N
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：Fontan 相关肝病 (FALD) 可能进展为门静脉高压、腹水和结节性肝重塑。 临床提示：这些案例表明，实质性...
portal_hypertension.abstract: Fontan-associated liver disease (FALD) may progress to portal hypertension, ascites, and nodular liver remodelling. Two-dimensional shear wave elastography (2D-SWE) can be performed in patients with ascites, but its reliability in this setting remains uncertain. We report two post-Fontan patients with ascites and nodular liver morphology on B-mode ultrasound who showed markedly discordant liver stiffness values. The pediatric patient had high stiffness (median 24.25 kPa; IQR/median 3.4%), whereas the adult patient with clinical decompensation, large-volume ascites, and pleural effusion had unexpectedly low stiffness (median 9.55 kPa; IQR/median 23.6%). portal_hypertension.title: Downregulation of COX-2 expression in liver sinusoidal endothelial cell prevented the formation of liver sinusoidal microthrombi through the AKT/mTOR/TSP-1 axis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Qian S, Gan C, Zhao C
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：肝窦微血栓形成（LST）被认为是慢性肝病纤维形成和门静脉高压的起始事件。 临床提示：肝窦内皮细胞 (LSEC) 衍生的化学引诱剂招募中性粒细胞和巨噬细胞，促进充血性肝病 (CH) 中的 LST。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Liver sinusoidal microthrombosis (LST) is recognized as an initiating event in fibrogenesis and portal hypertension in chronic liver diseases. Liver sinusoidal endothelial cell (LSEC)-derived chemoattractants recruit neutrophils and macrophages, promoting LST in congestive hepatopathy (CH). However, the driving molecules from LSECs for LST remain unclear. This study aims to elucidate that LSECs inflammatory via cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) upregulation triggers metabolic reprogramming promoting thrombospondin-1 (TSP-1)-mediated LST and portal hypertension.
